text: inside of the cart/editor when i extrude from an edge it does not keep the next extrusions edge in focus, really annoying to have to go and click it again
resolution: Edge extrusion now treats focusing the newly-created outer edge as a required transaction postcondition. The host resolves it through a tolerance-safe boundary-edge lookup, replaces any prior selection, and rolls back rather than leaving a successful extrusion unfocused. Added a native mesh-selection regression test.
